title: Orbs seen with unmarked black helicopters

tellings.quote: you guys often see or sometimes see are orbs accompanied by these unmarked black helicopters.

plain: Skinwalker Ranch is a property in Utah known for reports of strange events. Talking with its owner, a podcast host, Jesse Michels, says that people there sometimes see orbs, glowing balls of light, accompanied by unmarked black helicopters. The suggestion is that someone with resources is watching or following the orbs.
